reviews.author: Kitty Williamson
reviews.text: Ronnie Oxendine and crew are excellent roofers. Been in business for over 40 yrs. Alot of the workers are long time employees. They are very courteous, respectful of your property and very hard workers. They put in our solar skylights a few yrs ago and just finished replacing our roof. They did an excellent job and I bet you cannot find a nail on the ground anywhere !! Fair and honest company.

reviews.author: Sherry Lowe
reviews.text: I am retracting a less than favorable review I recently put on Google because we (mistakenly) thought 2 different types of shingles had been used when we had a new roof put on our house several years ago (a large number of the shingles appeared to be different colors & it worsened over time). We were wrong! After my review Oxendine & Sons Roofing immediately reached out to us and Ronnie came by our house to take a look at the roof. As soon as he saw it he said he would get a rep from the factory out here because there was something wrong with the shingles. The factory rep came out to our house today and said there was definitely a manufacturing issue with the shingles and they (the manufacturer of the shingles) would replace the entire roof. This was absolutely no fault at all of Oxendine & Sons Roofing. They have been nothing but professional and responsive to this issue - and we would absolutely use them again and recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Marcella Clark
reviews.text: We had Oxendine put a new roof on about 9 years ago and during a recent storm some shingles had come off. They came and fixed it. I appreciate Ronnie, Judy and staff at Oxendine Roofing.

reviews.author: Scott Morgan
reviews.text: They came out and got the job finished quickly. They cleaned up the work area and were surprisingly quiet. Also installed some nice looking black drip edge, all the way around the entire house. Everything looks great

reviews.author: Izzy Bogans
reviews.text: they done a good job. they replaced the back roof a few years ago. that's why i called them back to do my front roof. oxendine is professional at what they do.

reviews.author: Graham Pope
reviews.text: They have done work for me for a long time and have always pleased me. They do great work and always leave job sites cleaner than they found it.
